description.value: This definitive, multi-centre study uses post-mortem confirmed cases to evaluate six visual rating scales, their relationship with grey matter volume loss, diagnostic value compared with expert scan assessment, and a machine learning approach to predict underlying pathology.

spans.text: This definitive, multi-centre study uses post-mortem confirmed cases as the gold standard to: (i) assess the reliability of six visual rating scales; (ii) determine their associated pattern of atrophy; (iii) compare their diagnostic value with expert scan assessment; and (iv) assess the accuracy of a machine learning approach based on multiple rating scales to predict underlying pathology.

description.value: Structural T1-weighted MRI preprocessing for voxel-based morphometry: initial rigid registration to the ICBM152 template using Reg-Aladin/NiftyReg, manual registration checks and adjustments, unified tissue segmentation with bias correction and rigid registration, iterative groupwise alignment with Dartel, modulation to account for local volume changes, and 6-mm FWHM Gaussian smoothing. The pipeline produced grey-matter maps for voxelwise correlation with visual rating scores.
